steps.note: CSRB report cites a scan spike under two hours after publication, 400 attempts/sec at day five, botnet recon and research noise.
Cloudflare shows ${lower} tricks to evade simple jndi blocking and Microsoft notes upper/lower obfuscation to bypass string matching.
Apache says attackers who control log messages can exploit it; Microsoft lists User-Agent, account name and in-game messages as vectors.
Apache/CVE say JNDI does not guard against attacker-controlled LDAP endpoints, CSRB dates the feature to 2013/2.0-beta9, Cloudflare shows LDAP/DNS callbacks.
Apache and GHSA say arbitrary code is loaded from LDAP servers with CVSS 10.0 (AC:L/PR:N/UI:N); CISA says full control.
AA21-356A cites FBI seeing cryptomining and botnet malware; Microsoft notes rapid uptake into Mirai.
Microsoft reports Cobalt Strike, PowerShell reverse shells and Meterpreter; reported label fits.
Microsoft reports Mimikatz credential theft, Cobalt Strike lateral movement and data exfiltration.
Microsoft covers access brokers selling to RaaS, Khonsari via modified Minecraft servers and DEV-0401 NightSky from 4 Jan; CSRB notes Jan-Mar 2022 cases.
Microsoft names China/Iran/North Korea/Turkey groups, PHOSPHORUS and HAFNIUM; CSRB found no pre-disclosure state use.
